page.layout: One page, blank except for a handwritten inscription in the centre-top; no printed text.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. It carries only a handwritten inscription in ink, in English, signed "J.B.". Handwriting is outside the transcription scope, so it is not transcribed. The inscription reads, in substance: "This Book I am informed is in great request in Holland, the chief scene of action; where it always fetches a high price, whenever it occurs for sale."
